title: cosec x = −2
caption: cosec x = 1/sin x has branches above 1 and below −1. The line y = −2 meets only the lower branch, twice: where sin x = −½, at x = 210° and 330°.
alt: The cosecant graph from 0° to 360°: an upward U on 0°–180° and a downward U on 180°–360°, with the line y = −2 meeting the lower branch at 210° and 330°.
description: cosec x is 1/sin x, so it has asymptotes wherever sin x = 0: at 0°, 180° and 360°.
Between 0° and 180° the branch lies above y = 1; between 180° and 360° it lies below y = −1.
The line y = −2 cuts the lower branch at 210° and 330°, where sin x = −½.
